do you want me to explain the strategy?
there's a bit of thought behind this build
and by a bit of thought I mean very very little
the ONLY important unit in this build is alva, the one in the back
you want to give her her wheel as soon as possible
will unyielding increases strike damage by 100% and makes strike give fortress, which reduces dmg taken by 50%
all of alva's damaging cards count as strike
so she's tanky and deals a ton of damage
units like leigh and ghelot are there to thin out the enemy team and keep alva alive until you only draw her cards
pandia is there to exalt often on alva, her exalt takes some aliemus but gives 3 amplification, which is undispellable and grants +10% damage, healing, shielding and everything per stack
pandia also gives charge, which increases strike damage per stack but is used up when a "strike" is used
you'll figure stuff out as you play
specifically which characters do what and which characters counter alva and how to target them faster
eventually you'll make your own build
